leg: Europe → SFO one-way (family of 5): baseline Mon Oct 26 / Tue Oct 27, 2026 vs extension to Sun Nov 1 / Mon Nov 2, 2026 (gateways AMS/CDG/DUB/LHR), incl. Croatia-thru-Oct-30 → Dublin Halloween variant

options.label: (1) FARES — AMS (KLM) Nov 1-2 vs Oct 26-27
options.detail: KLM operates AMS-SFO daily (7x/wk, 787) year-round, so no schedule risk either window. Google Flights currently shows cheapest one-way AMS→SFO at $512 departing Fri Oct 30; Expedia shows one-ways from $403 (connections). KLM's own site prices Oct 6-Nov 3 round-trips from $996, implying nonstop one-ways roughly $500-700 economy in both windows. Business one-way typical $2,500-3,500. The Oct-26-27 vs Nov-1-2 delta at AMS is small (~5-10%, maybe $30-80/pax) because Dutch autumn school holidays end mid-October — AMS is already post-surge by Oct 26.
options.notes: Per-person one-way economy nonstop estimate. Daily service = best irrops resilience of the four gateways.

options.label: (1) FARES — CDG (Air France) Nov 1-2 vs Oct 26-27
options.detail: AF flies CDG-SFO daily year-round. Caution on the extension thesis at CDG specifically: French Toussaint school holidays run ~Oct 17-Nov 2, 2026, so Sun Nov 1 is the FRENCH family return-crunch day — CDG fares Nov 1 may be equal to or higher than Oct 26-27; Mon Nov 2 should be cleaner. Typical economy one-way $500-750; business $2,800-4,000. The 'post-half-term drop' is a UK phenomenon and does not map onto CDG until Nov 2-3.
options.source: General AF schedule + French Toussaint calendar (Zone dates ~Oct 17-Nov 2, 2026); fare level per momondo/Expedia route aggregates https://www.momondo.com/flights/europe/united-states
options.notes: Per-person one-way economy estimate. If flying AF, prefer Nov 2 over Nov 1.

options.label: (1) FARES — DUB (Aer Lingus EI61) Nov 1-2: cheapest gateway, schedule VERIFY flag
options.detail: November is explicitly the cheapest month DUB→SFO: Google Flights typical November tickets $460-690; Skyscanner best one-way $342; momondo recent best one-way $635, EI average $731. Business one-way ~$2,000-3,000 cash (A330 1-2-1 lie-flat; cheapest lie-flat option to/from Dublin per BusinessClassSignal). EI61 Nov 1/2 operation: NOT yet confirmable from published schedules. Winter 2025-26 precedent: from Nov 2, 2025 EI61 operated Mon/Sat/Sun (A330-300, DUB 12:30→SFO 15:30), later Mon/Tue/Fri — i.e., roughly 3-5x weekly in winter, and BOTH Sunday and Monday appear in the historical winter operating-day pattern, so Sun Nov 1 and Mon Nov 2, 2026 are LIKELY operating days, plus US-DOT-filed AA/BA/IB codeshares. Must verify on the Aer Lingus booking engine before committing — winter 2026-27 days-of-week are not published in third-party timetables yet.
options.notes: Status 'unknown' applies ONLY to EI61 operating Nov 1/2 specifically; the fare level itself is well-supported. Winter frequency cut (daily→~3-5x/wk) starts with IATA winter season Sun Oct 25, 2026.

options.label: (1) FARES — LHR Nov 1-2 vs Oct 26-27: the half-term drop is REAL here
options.detail: England/Wales October half term 2026 is Mon Oct 26 - Fri Oct 30 (confirmed by Greenwich, Ealing, Haringey councils) — meaning the current baseline Oct 26-27 departure dates sit INSIDE UK half-term week, when Which? found fares run ~42% above well-booked levels. Kids return to school Mon Nov 2. LHR→SFO Nov 1-2 should show the largest fare relief of the four gateways — historically 15-30% below half-term-week pricing on UK-origin leisure demand (typical Nov economy one-way $450-650 vs $600-850 half-term week; business $2,500-4,000). Ex-EU average Nov Europe→US fare benchmark: ~$666 (2nd-cheapest month after February at ~$654).
options.source: https://www.royalgreenwich.gov.uk/schools-and-education/school-term-dates/term-dates-2026-2027 ; https://www.ealing.gov.uk/info/201123/your_child_at_school/119/term_and_holiday_dates/2 ; Which? half-term fare study via https://www.euronews.com/2022/09/28/half-term-holidays-with-flight-prices-soaring-how-can-you-save-money-on-your-next-family-g ; https://www.going.com/flights/to/europe
options.notes: Answer to 'is the post-half-term drop real': YES for LHR (order 15-30%), modest for AMS/DUB (5-15%), and possibly INVERTED at CDG on Nov 1 (Toussaint returns). Note one caveat: Sunday departures average ~$849 vs midweek ~$674 Europe→US, which erodes some of the Nov 1 (Sunday) advantage — Mon Nov 2 is the better fare day.

options.label: (2) AWARD SPACE — Flying Blue Nov 1-2 vs Oct 26-27, and the 30k PE promo
options.detail: CORROBORATED on both points. (a) November among FB's best months: skystatus and multiple analyses name Jan-Mar and November as the best saver-availability/lowest-mile months on AF/KLM; Frequent Miler specifically flagged strong Europe→US November availability. So 5 seats of lie-flat saver (60k biz floor) across Nov 1-2 is materially more likely than Oct 26-27 (which sits in half-term/Toussaint demand) — but SFO-specific business saver is inconsistent (OMAAT found zero on some SFO route checks), so 'more likely' not 'assured'; premium economy availability is consistently better than business. (b) Promo window: the August 2026 Promo Rewards (book Aug 1-31) include 25% off KLM PREMIUM ECONOMY Europe↔SFO from 30,000 miles one-way (vs 40k floor), with travel valid THROUGH JANUARY 31, 2027 — Nov 1-2 is inside the window and no blackout dates are published. It is capacity-controlled per date (promo inventory, not guaranteed on every date) and must be BOOKED BY AUG 31, 2026.
options.notes: price_usd = approx per-person taxes/fees+value proxy; the promo award itself is 30,000 miles + ~$100-150 fees per person AMS→SFO in PE. 5 x 30k = 150k miles for the family one-way in premium economy if promo inventory exists on Nov 1 or 2 — check the FB award calendar NOW (booking deadline Aug 31 is 29 days away).

options.label: (3) HALLOWEEN PROGRAMMING — what Nov 1-2 unlocks (kids 8/13/16)
options.detail: Disneyland Paris Halloween Festival: Sep 26 - SUN NOV 1, 2026 (official) — the extension captures the finale weekend; NO separately-ticketed Oct 31 party in 2026, replaced by all-guest extended hours to 11pm on Halloween night with 'A Nightfall with Disney Villains' castle show (officially confirmed format change). Tivoli Copenhagen Halloween: Oct 2 - Sun Nov 1, 2026 (official; park then closes until mid-Nov Christmas opening). Amsterdam Museumnacht: Sat NOV 7, 2026 — MISSED even by the Nov 1-2 extension (official Instagram confirms). Dublin: CONFLICT — official Bram Stoker Festival channels (site/Instagram/Facebook) say Fri Oct 23 - Mon Oct 26, 2026 (the Irish October bank-holiday weekend, Mon Oct 26), while third-party tourism sites claim Oct 30 - Nov 2 with a Macnas parade in the middle; official channels win → the festival and its Macnas Dublin parade most likely happen Oct 23-26 and an Oct 30-Nov 2 Dublin stay would MISS them, keeping only actual-Halloween-night city atmosphere (Temple Bar/street celebrations), Pumpkins After Dark at Newbridge House (all October), Malahide Castle Halloween events, ghost tours. Full programme drops in September — re-verify then. London: half-term crowds/rates end Fri Oct 30; November is off-peak with 20-40% hotel discounts per UK hotel-pricing guides, so Nov 1-2 London nights are cheaper and quieter.
options.notes: price_usd = rough per-person/day park admission proxy (DLP 1-day from ~EUR 62-105). Confirmed items: DLP and Tivoli end dates, Museumnacht date, no-DLP-party-2026. The Dublin festival-dates conflict is the one open item — official says Oct 23-26.

options.label: (4a) EXTENSION MATH — big-city variant: +6-7 nights (Oct 25/26 → Nov 1/2) in AMS/CDG/LHR
options.detail: Incremental cost: family of 5 needs 2 rooms or a family room. Post-surge (Nov 1+) mid-range: London ~$400-500/night for 2 rooms (Nov = off-peak, 20-40% below peak; Sunday nights cheapest ~$366 avg), Paris similar but Toussaint demand holds through Nov 1, Amsterdam ~$350-450. 6 extra nights lodging ~$2,200-3,000 + food/activities/transit ~$150-250/day ~$1,000-1,600. Total incremental ~$3,200-4,600. Offsetting flight savings vs Oct 26-27 cash fares: modest, ~$30-150/pax x 5 = $150-750 (largest ex-LHR). NET: the extension costs ~$2,500-4,400 more in cash — it does NOT pay for itself on fares alone. It CAN pay for itself if the FB 30k PE promo hits on Nov 1-2 (5 x PE at 30k miles + ~$125 fees vs 5 x ~$1,200-1,800 cash PE, or vs 5 x ~$550 economy = the family flies up 2 cabins for less cash than economy).
options.source: https://www.hotelshotspot.co.uk/article/uk-hotel-costs-prices ; https://www.kayak.com/London-Hotels.28501.hotel.ksp ; fare deltas per sources in options 1-4
options.notes: price_usd = midpoint total incremental cash cost of the 6-night big-city extension before any award-ticket offset. Buy decision hinges on the FB promo/award check, not on cash-fare savings.

options.label: (4b) EXTENSION MATH — Croatia-thru-Oct-30 → Dublin Halloween variant (RECOMMENDED cost shape)
options.detail: Stay Croatia Oct 25-30 (5 extra nights, deep post-season: quality apartment for 5 ~$120-220/night = $600-1,100 incl. food premium ~$1,200-1,900 all-in) → Ryanair DBV-DUB Fri Oct 30 (winter-schedule flight confirmed loaded per prior research; typical Ryanair fare EUR 40-90/pax + bags → ~$350-600 for 5) → Dublin Fri Oct 30-Sun Nov 1 or Mon Nov 2 (2-3 nights; Halloween-weekend hotel surge +30-50% per Dublin guides → ~$300-450/night for family config = $600-1,350) → EI61 DUB-SFO Nov 1 or 2 economy ~$450-650/pax = $2,250-3,250 for 5 (vs ~$2,750 baseline ex-AMS/CDG Oct 26-27 — roughly a wash, slight save). END-TO-END incremental vs Oct 25 baseline: ~+$2,400-3,900 total for 7 extra Europe days including actual Halloween night (Sat Oct 31) in Dublin. Cheaper than the big-city variant because 5 of 7 extra nights are cheap Croatian post-season nights. CAVEATS: (i) per official dates, Bram Stoker Festival/Macnas parade is Oct 23-26 — this itinerary likely gets Halloween street atmosphere + Pumpkins After Dark + castle events, NOT the festival; (ii) Ryanair→Aer Lingus is separate-ticket, but the 2-night Dublin buffer fully absorbs a DBV-DUB delay/cancel; (iii) EI61 Nov 1/2 operating days need booking-engine verification (see option 3).
options.source: Dublin Halloween hotel surge: https://www.dublintourism.org/dublin-halloween/ ; DUB-SFO fares: https://www.google.com/travel/flights/flights-from-dublin-to-san-francisco.html ; festival dates: https://bramstokerfestival.com/en/ ; Croatia post-season rates: historical-typical
options.notes: price_usd = midpoint total incremental cost vs Oct 25 baseline. Best cost-per-extra-day of the two variants and lands the family in an English-speaking city for actual Halloween night with a buffer before the long-haul.

options.label: (5) TRAVEL-MECHANICAL DOWNSIDES of Nov 1-2 departure
options.detail: (i) IATA winter season begins Sun Oct 25, 2026: DUB-SFO drops from ~daily to ~3-5x weekly (2025-26 precedent: Mon/Sat/Sun then Mon/Tue/Fri) — fewer same-route rebooking options after irrops; AMS (KLM daily) and CDG (AF daily) keep daily service, LHR-SFO remains multiple-daily (UA/BA/VS). (ii) Clock misalignment: Europe falls back Oct 25, US Nov 1 — during Oct 26-31 the offset is 8h not 9h (only affects the pre-extension week); on Nov 1 itself US DST ends, so arrival-day timings shift. (iii) Nov 1 = All Saints' Day public holiday (France/parts of Europe): some closures and heavy French domestic return traffic; also Sunday transatlantic departures price ~$150+ above midweek on average. (iv) Separate-ticket exposure on the Ryanair DBV-DUB leg (mitigated by 2-night buffer). (v) Dublin Halloween-weekend hotel surge (+30-50% Oct 30-Nov 1) claws back some of the fare savings. No weather showstoppers — late Oct/early Nov North Atlantic ops are routine; school absence excluded per instructions.
options.source: https://info.flightmapper.net/flight/Aer_Lingus_EI_61 ; https://www.flight.info/EI61 ; https://www.going.com/flights/to/europe ; IATA winter season calendar (starts last Sunday of October)
options.notes: None of these kill the extension; the only hard gate is EI61's Nov 1/2 operating days if the Dublin variant is chosen.

summary: The extension to Nov 1-2 is viable and moderately attractive, but for programming and award-space reasons, not cash-fare reasons. FARES: the post-half-term drop is real but gateway-specific — England's half term is exactly Oct 26-30, 2026, so the current Oct 26-27 baseline departs INSIDE UK half-term week; Nov 1-2 saves an estimated 15-30% ex-LHR, 5-15% ex-AMS/DUB, and possibly nothing ex-CDG on Nov 1 (French Toussaint holidays end Nov 2, making Sun Nov 1 the French return-crunch day — fly Mon Nov 2 if CDG). November is documented as the cheapest/2nd-cheapest Europe→US month (~$666 avg economy). AWARDS: corroborated that November is among Flying Blue's best saver months, and the live August 2026 Promo Rewards list confirms KLM premium economy Europe↔SFO from 30,000 miles with travel valid through Jan 31, 2027 — Nov 1-2 is inside the window with no published blackout, but promo inventory is per-date capacity-controlled and must be booked by Aug 31, 2026, so check the FB calendar for Nov 1-2 immediately; 5 PE seats at 30k each would make the extension strongly cost-positive. PROGRAMMING: Disneyland Paris Halloween Festival officially runs through Sun Nov 1 (no ticketed Oct 31 party in 2026 — replaced by all-guest extended hours to 11pm with a Villains castle show); Tivoli Halloween also ends Nov 1; Amsterdam Museumnacht is Nov 7 (missed either way); Dublin is the wrinkle — official Bram Stoker Festival channels say Oct 23-26 (bank-holiday weekend), contradicting third-party claims of Oct 30-Nov 2, so the Croatia→Dublin variant would get real Halloween night (Sat Oct 31) street atmosphere, Pumpkins After Dark, and castle events but likely NOT the festival/Macnas parade. MATH: big-city 6-night extension costs ~$2,500-4,400 net incremental; the Croatia-thru-Oct-30 → Ryanair DBV-DUB Fri Oct 30 → Dublin Halloween weekend → EI61 home Nov 1/2 variant is the better cost shape at ~$2,400-3,900 incremental because five of the extra nights are cheap Croatian post-season nights. Hard gate: EI61's winter operating days for Nov 1/2 aren't published yet — 2025-26 precedent (Sun and Mon both operating days) makes it likely, but verify on the Aer Lingus booking engine before committing.
caveats: Fare figures are aggregator estimates and historical-typical ranges, not live locked quotes — no booking engine was queried with the exact 5-passenger itinerary; live-check before deciding. EI61 operating days for Nov 1-2, 2026 are inferred from the 2025-26 winter pattern (unconfirmed for winter 2026-27; status flagged unknown). The Flying Blue 30k PE promo is confirmed live (travel window through Jan 31, 2027) but is per-date capacity-controlled with an Aug 31, 2026 booking deadline — promo availability on Nov 1-2 specifically was not verified seat-by-seat. Dublin Bram Stoker Festival 2026 dates are contested between official channels (Oct 23-26) and third-party tourism sites (Oct 30-Nov 2); official dates were preferred but the full programme publishes in September — re-verify then, as it changes the value of the Dublin variant. Hotel figures are city-level typical ranges for a family of 5 in 2 mid-range rooms, not property quotes. Ryanair DBV-DUB Oct 30 was taken as confirmed-loaded from the caller's prior research and not re-verified here.
